name: es20-vertex-attributes
title: Vertex attributes
summary: Attribute data types and normalization (BYTE..FLOAT, FIXED 16.16), component counts, interleaved/planar/packed layouts, constant attribute values, client-memory arrays on VAO 0, glBindAttribLocation vs glGetAttribLocation, glGetActiveAttrib and vertex-attribute state queries, all checked against CPU references.
spec: ES 3.0 §2.1.5 Fixed-Point Computation, §2.1.6 Fixed-Point Data Conversions (equations 2.1, 2.2)
ES 3.0 §2.9 Vertex Arrays (Table 2.4, footnote 5), §2.9.1 Transferring Array Elements
ES 3.0 §2.10.6 Vertex Arrays in Buffer Objects
ES 3.0 §6.1.10 Vertex Array Object Queries, §6.1.12 Shader and Program Queries (GetVertexAttrib*, GetVertexAttribPointerv)
GLSL ES 3.00 §4.3.4 Input Variables, §4.3.8.1 Input Layout Qualifiers

api.glGenBuffers: VBOs whose contents are observed through rendered cells
api.glBindBuffer: ARRAY_BUFFER binding captured by glVertexAttribPointer; later re-binding does not change VERTEX_ATTRIB_ARRAY_BUFFER_BINDING
api.glBufferData: attribute data (8 integer/fixed/float formats, 4 layouts, 4 sizes) observed through pixels
api.glGenVertexArrays: per-layout VAOs and scratch VAOs; glIsVertexArray FALSE before first bind
api.glBindVertexArray: VAO 0 vs non-zero VAO selects client-array legality and which attribute state is queried
api.glDeleteVertexArrays: glIsVertexArray FALSE afterwards; final glGetError == NO_ERROR
api.glIsVertexArray: FALSE for a generated unbound name, TRUE after bind, FALSE after delete
api.glEnableVertexAttribArray: VERTEX_ATTRIB_ARRAY_ENABLED; array overrides the constant; index == MAX_VERTEX_ATTRIBS -> INVALID_VALUE
api.glDisableVertexAttribArray: clears only the enable flag; disabled array shows the constant value in pixels
api.glVertexAttribPointer: 17 type/normalized cases, sizes 1..4, stride/offset layouts, client pointers on VAO 0; state read back; INVALID_VALUE (index, size 5, negative stride) and INVALID_OPERATION (client pointer on non-zero VAO)
api.glVertexAttrib4f: pixel (x,y,z,w) incl. alpha; index == MAX_VERTEX_ATTRIBS -> INVALID_VALUE; also drives the cross-VAO current-value check
api.glVertexAttrib4fv: pixel (x,y,z,w) incl. alpha and CURRENT_VERTEX_ATTRIB exact; unchanged after drawing from an enabled array
api.glGetVertexAttribiv: ENABLED, SIZE, STRIDE, TYPE, NORMALIZED, INTEGER, DIVISOR, BUFFER_BINDING, CURRENT_VERTEX_ATTRIB compared with expected values; index == MAX -> INVALID_VALUE
api.glGetVertexAttribfv: CURRENT_VERTEX_ATTRIB exact equality; SIZE as float
api.glGetVertexAttribPointerv: byte offsets and client addresses compared exactly; NULL in the initial state
api.glBindAttribLocation: bound slots reported by glGetAttribLocation; no effect until relink; reserved gl_ name -> INVALID_OPERATION; index == MAX -> INVALID_VALUE; aliasing -> link failure
api.glGetAttribLocation: bound, linker-chosen, inactive (-1) and unlinked-program (INVALID_OPERATION) cases; layout(location) beats glBindAttribLocation
api.glGetActiveAttrib: 7 active attributes: name, type (FLOAT..FLOAT_MAT2, INT_VEC2, UNSIGNED_INT), size 1; index == ACTIVE_ATTRIBUTES -> INVALID_VALUE with outputs unmodified
api.glGetProgramiv: ACTIVE_ATTRIBUTES, ACTIVE_ATTRIBUTE_MAX_LENGTH, LINK_STATUS (success and aliasing failure)
api.glCreateProgram: programs used for validated draws and scratch link experiments
api.glAttachShader: both stages attached before glBindAttribLocation + glLinkProgram
api.glLinkProgram: LINK_STATUS TRUE for valid programs, relink applies new bindings, FALSE for aliased attributes
api.glDeleteShader: cleanup of shaders attached to the scratch programs
api.glUseProgram: three programs drawn in the validated frame
api.glUniform4f: gain and bias observed in the pixel values
api.glDrawArrays: TRIANGLE_STRIP and TRIANGLES over all arrays; pixels compared with the CPU reference
api.glViewport: one viewport per cell; center pixels probed
api.glClearColor: gap and empty cells show the clear color
api.glClear: COLOR_BUFFER_BIT; alpha-only clear checked with glColorMask
api.glColorMask: alpha-only clear leaves RGB intact while making alpha opaque
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE readback of every probed pixel
api.glGetError: drained and compared for 11 error conditions (INVALID_VALUE and INVALID_OPERATION)

visual_review.notes: 256x256 radeonsi es-max capture (alpha made opaque): dark-blue background with an 8x8 grid of flat cells. Left two columns, one row per type (UBYTE, BYTE, USHORT, SHORT, UINT, INT, FIXED, FLOAT): each row is an identical left/right pair (orange, orange-yellow, magenta, orange, magenta, orange, pink-red, orange); a near-black navy cell beside the BYTE row is the -128/-127/-126 edge case. Column 3: red, green, blue, orange (component counts 1-4), then three client-array cells (orange-red, blue, lime) and an orange glBindAttribLocation cell; the linker-location cell (cyan-blue) is in column 4, row 7. Top right: four identical 2x2 panels with blue/orange upper and red/teal lower quads and an empty gap (the four memory layouts). Below them eight constant-attribute cells (red, dark red, green, orange / blue, magenta, orange, teal) and the enabled-array green + restored-constant teal pair. No artifacts, no transparency.
